newsitem.title: USA: Helmerich & Payne says gas prices helped Q1 net.
newsitem.headline: Helmerich & Payne says gas prices helped Q1 net.

text.p: Helmerich & Payne Inc said Thursday higher natural gas prices and increased output helped first-quarter earnings climb by 81 percent.
The company reported net income of $20.1 million in the quarter ended December 31, compared to $11.1 million a year ago. Revenues climbed to $118.3 million from $88.4 million last year.

"Natural gas prices have fluctuated wildly so far this winter," said Hans Helmerich, the energy company's president and chief executive. "Our businesses should continue to benefit from the tightening of supply and the corresponding increase in activity levels and dayrates for our U.S. land rig fleet."
Helmerich & Payne shares were trading up 2-3/8 Thursday at 53-3/4.
